title: Vintage Porcelain Raggedy Ann Doll – 18” Red Yarn Hair & Pinafore
categoryName: Dolls & Bears:Dolls, Clothing & Accessories:Dolls & Doll Playsets
descriptionText:
Charming vintage-style Raggedy Ann collectible doll with a porcelain head, hands, and feet, and a soft cloth body. She wears her signature red floral dress with a white pinafore, decorated with red ric-rac trim and heart buttons. Her bright red yarn hair, painted nose, and sweet smile make her a perfect addition to any Raggedy Ann or doll collection.
Details:

Height: approx. 18 inches
Material: Porcelain head, hands, and feet with cloth torso
Hair: Red yarn
Outfit: Red floral dress, white pinafore with lace trim
Condition: Pre-owned, excellent display condition. No cracks, chips, or major flaws. Minor signs of age. Please review photos for details.
Perfect for:
Collectors, vintage toy lovers, or fans of classic Americana.
